infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Avishkaar uses your location to verify on-site check-ins within 25 km and prefill coordinates when sharing a hidden gem.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Avishkaar to attach photos and short clips (<8 MB) to hidden gem field guides.
